dimensions.note: No credential input, storage, logging, provider, or network facility exists; tokenBudget is a token-count field, not a secret.
Each method logs structured entry and completion/replay events without content.
Strict validation and all freshness, registry, budget, and replay checks occur before writes.
Synthetic success, malformed/stale/tampered, replay/idempotency, and no-authority paths are covered.
Exact replay returns no handles; conflicting replay throws before writing.
The extension makes no external API or network calls.
No files, processes, connections, providers, or external resources are opened.
README and fixtures contain only example identifiers and repository://example references.
Every object input and resource boundary uses z.strictObject; output authority is a literal none.
All immutable context resources explicitly use infinite lifetime and bounded version GC.
This is an immutable compiler, not a remote-resource CRUD lifecycle.
Methods only validate and persist local immutable records; they perform no external mutation.
Each method deterministically uses its artifact identifier and writes exactly one matching spec.
Initial standalone model version; no prior published resource contract exists.
